nodes.label: Visual Metadata Authorization Boundary
nodes.rationale: Theme, brand, icon, and badge are presentation-only metadata and do not decide permissions or data access.

nodes.label: Embedded Asset Strategy
nodes.rationale: Local embedded icons avoid external web dependencies and permit complete resource packaging.

nodes.label: Combat Input Suppression
nodes.rationale: Combat controls are blocked while movement input passes through to avoid accidental actions during menu interaction.

nodes.label: Backward-Compatible Exports
nodes.rationale: The native interface retains the prior API so existing resources can migrate without changing menu calls.

nodes.label: Cross-Resource Event Pattern
nodes.rationale: Cross-resource menus use event plus args because local function callbacks only work in the creating resource.

nodes.label: Server-Side Security Boundary
nodes.rationale: Authorization, persistence, and business rules remain in the calling resource because menu visibility is not a security control.
